items.name: LearnQuick
items.description: 🎴 LearnQuick is a flashcard application that you can study with decks and cards. The main function of the application is to show the front sides of the created cards to the user and ask them to guess the back of the card. As a result of self-assessment of user's ability to guess the back sides of the displayed cards, the cards that user weak against are shown more often, and the cards that user strong against are shown less frequently.
